import re

test_cases = [
    ('hello       world', '{:<} world'),  # line 179 - left aligned

]

for text, fmt in test_cases:
    print(f'Testing parse({fmt!r}, {text!r})')
    
    if '<}' in fmt:
        # Left alignment: {:<} world -> (.+?) * world$
        old_expr = r'^(.+?) * world$'
        new_expr = r'^(\S+) * world$'
        
        m_old = re.match(old_expr, text)
        m_new = re.match(new_expr, text)
        print(f'  OLD pattern: {m_old.groups() if m_old else \"No match\"}')
        print(f'  NEW pattern: {m_new.groups() if m_new else \"No match\"}')
        
    elif '^}' in fmt:
        # Center alignment: hello {:^} world -> ^ * (.+?) * world$
        old_expr = r'^hello *(.+?) * world$'
        new_expr = r'^hello *(\S+) * world$'
        
        m_old = re.match(old_expr, text)
        m_new = re.match(new_expr, text)
        print(f'  OLD pattern: {m_old.groups() if m_old else \"No match\"}')
        print(f'  NEW pattern: {m_new.groups() if m_new else \"No match\"}')
" 2>&1 | grep -v "^/"
